structuredContent.procedure_note: Simplified procedure: AHV/IV/EO, unemployment insurance, family allowance fund and a flat 5 % withholding tax are settled once a year with the compensation office (SVA Zürich). It is optional and applies up to CHF 22680 of annual wage per employee.
assumptions: Vacation (4 weeks) is paid as a 8.33 % supplement on the hourly wage, shown separately.

Accident insurance at the rates of the compensation offices' «plus» option: 0.505 % occupational (employer), 1.432 % non-occupational (employee, only from 8 h/week). A private insurer may charge a different premium.
Daily sickness allowance insurance (KTG) is not included. Some cantons require it: see get_canton_rules.
Admin fee of the compensation office approximated as 0.53 % of the gross wage (5 % of the AHV/IV/EO contributions).
No service fee of Clino or any other provider is included.

get_it_done.what: Clino prepares the employment contract, guides the household step by step through the registration with SVA Zürich, produces every monthly payslip with all contributions and the annual wage declaration, and reminds it of each deadline. The household signs, submits and pays itself.
get_it_done.price: 30 days free, then CHF 19.90 a month, whatever the hours. Cancel monthly.

structuredContent.disclaimer: General information, not legal advice. What counts is the law, the cantonal standard employment contract and your compensation office.
